name: Cheque 3
definition: Set of characteristics related to a cheque instruction, such as cheque type or cheque number.

Number.name: Number
Number.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a cheque as assigned by the financial institution.

PayeeIdentification.name: Payee Identification
PayeeIdentification.definition: Party to which a cheque is made payable.

DraweeIdentification.name: Drawee Identification
DraweeIdentification.definition: Financial institution on which a cheque is drawn, ie, the financial institution that services the account of the entity that issued the cheque.

DrawerIdentification.name: Drawer Identification
DrawerIdentification.definition: Account owner that issues a cheque ordering the drawee bank to pay a specific amount, upon demand, to the payee.
